interface.defaultPrompt: Check these physical print books at HPL Looscan: [titles and authors].
interface.longDescription: Find and verify physical print-book copies at Houston Public Library, at a selected branch or across HPL. This research workflow reports observed item availability, edition details, call numbers, catalog links, check times and remaining coverage. Quick checks stop at a confirmed available item; thorough checks aim to resolve all scoped candidates and holdings. Regular and large print are distinguished; digital, audio, DVDs, adaptations and kits are excluded from ordinary print requests. Incomplete checks remain Unable to verify and partial totals stay unknown. Requires host-provided tools that can inspect live catalog records and item rows. The plugin supplies instructions and an optional local evidence processor; it does not provide a browser or catalog connection. Manual installation through a repository marketplace is intended for supervised testing on supported desktop/Codex hosts. Availability and install options depend on the host, account and workspace. Reference-material status does not establish borrowing or transfer eligibility. Independent tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by Houston Public Library.

publication.release_notes: Add a repository marketplace and friend-testing installation guide, including an account-dependent private-import option. Clarify supported host requirements and public-directory submission status; remove pricing wording from the listing. The evidence processor is unchanged and the experimental retrieval prototype remains excluded.
